title: The team workspace as its own place: Home's lead agent hands work to a workspace Lead, which coordinates the team agents and returns one report to the Home chat
request: Make the workspace a separate place, and let the lead agent and the team agents work on tasks together in both directions. The owner chose both leads connected, and the workspace as its own top-level area.
spec: The approved plan magical-waddling-honey.md, packages L1 to L5
plan: L1 dclab-core 0.167.0: coordinator and entry kinds, AgentConfig v2, the Lead's and Home's directory rows, opening_refusal, delegation_refusal, LEAD_ROUTES.
L2 the Lead's and Home's deterministic rules on the team agents' tools, guard and outbox; one Home thread per draft.
L3 the lead agent's tool case_ask_teams and the built chat's ask_teams; a reply on Home goes to the waiting team question; the prompts say when to ask the teams.
L4 GET /api/workspace/overview and the Workspace page in the sidebar.
L5 tests on files, PostgreSQL and signed in; the free suites; review; records.

decisions.decision: Home opens a case only for the Lead, and the Lead hands work only to team agents
decisions.why: a request from Home always passes a coordinator that joins the replies, and the Lead never opens a case of its own

decisions.decision: The Lead and Home are scripted rules in this release
decisions.why: the owner's rule for team agents: AI agents only behind a switch, after a live paired test

decisions.decision: The Lead sends data work to Data Science only
decisions.why: Data Science is the only team agent that owns tasks in this release; ML Engineering, Sales and Marketing have no task-owning agent yet

decisions.decision: The kind of help travels as one help:<track> input that only the Lead reads
decisions.why: the task contract has no field for it, and the Lead strips it before any team sees the inputs

decisions.decision: One Home thread per draft, readable by the person who asked and by the owner
decisions.why: a person's own conversation with the Lead is theirs; roles are workspace-wide, so the project alone cannot say who may read it

decisions.decision: The Lead's report reaches Home as a chat message, without changing the Home page
decisions.why: another session keeps uncommitted work in home.html; a saved message is drawn by the page as it is

change: dclab_core team_work.py, CHANGELOG, schemas (agent_config v2); dclab_rnd teamspace/lead.py (new), agents.py, tools.py, threads.py; agents/case_agent.py; draft/orchestrator.py and api.py; agentic/routers/team_threads.py, api_models.py; accounts/guard.py; prompts case_agent.md, case_agent_think_first.md, home_orchestrator.md; web views/workspace.html (new), core.js, ds.css, build.py; scripts/browser_e2e.py; tests/test_lead_workspace.py (new), test_core_team_work.py, test_team_screens.py; CORE_INTEGRATION.md

findings.defect: A request with no table was not blocked by the Lead
findings.scenario: Home asked with no readable input; the Lead delegated anyway
findings.cause: check_prerequisites counted the help:<track> marker as a readable input
findings.fix: the marker is left out of the count

findings.defect: The contract's shape changed under the same version
findings.scenario: AgentKind gained two kinds while AgentConfig stayed v1
findings.cause: a widened enum is a new shape
findings.fix: AgentConfig v2, which reads v1 unchanged

findings.defect: A Lead step was refused when two deliverers handled one row
findings.scenario: signed in on PostgreSQL, the app's worker and a second deliverer took the same row; the second recorded the same action and got 'already recorded'
findings.cause: record() read, found nothing, and wrote, with no answer for a write made in between
findings.fix: a concurrent insert of the same attempt is read back and treated as that attempt

findings.defect: An answer written in the Home thread on the Teams tab went nowhere
findings.scenario: the thread said the next message is the answer, but only Business threads were read for answers
findings.fix: a Home thread's message answers the Lead's open question from that person

findings.defect: The Workspace page said 'Waiting for you' on another team's task
findings.scenario: the open-tasks list drew a team task waiting for a person
findings.fix: 'Waiting for you' only on the reader's own conversations
findings.test: seen in the browser at 1280 and 375 px

findings.defect: The local person was named 'local' by the Lead and 'owner' by the thread routes
findings.scenario: without sign-in, an answer posted in the Home thread did not match the case's person
findings.cause: two defaults for the same person

findings.defect: Test runs on PostgreSQL failed at random while the final gate ran
findings.scenario: my --pg runs and the gate's both used dclab_test_p<N>
findings.cause: two parallel runners share the per-worker database names
findings.fix: the gate was stopped and is rerun alone on the finished commit
findings.test: the same files pass when run alone

findings.defect: A second message right after an answer replaced the person's real answer
findings.scenario: Sara answered, then wrote again before the worker delivered; the team got the second text under the first answer's record
findings.cause: waiting() still found the task, Home sent a second answer with no record of its own, and the Lead passed down the last answer's words
findings.fix: waiting() skips an answered question, Home sends one answer per recorded response, and the Lead passes down the words of the answer it recorded

findings.defect: While a team question waited, every message in the draft was taken as the answer
findings.scenario: Omar wrote in Sara's shared draft; his message was refused as an answer, both user ids showed in the chat, and the chat stayed taken over
findings.cause: the message route checked only that a question waited
findings.fix: only the person the question was asked of answers it; anyone else's message goes to the agent

findings.defect: The Lead's report in the Home chat was readable by every workspace reader
findings.scenario: any member reading the shared draft saw Sara's teams' question and joined report
findings.cause: the card was saved in the draft, which has no per-person check, while its Home thread is the person's
findings.fix: the draft read and its event stream drop a Lead card for a reader who may not read its Home thread
findings.test: tests/test_lead_workspace.py SignedInLeadRouteTests (Omar sees no Lead card; Sara does)

findings.defect: Two people asking from one draft shared one Home thread
findings.scenario: Omar's task landed in Sara's thread: she read his request, and his own task page was refused
findings.cause: the Home thread was keyed by the draft only
findings.fix: one Home thread per draft and person

findings.defect: A request asked again after a block did nothing, while the agent said the teams had it
findings.scenario: the same words after the blocker was fixed returned the blocked task with opened false
findings.cause: the task id came from the draft and the words only
findings.fix: an ended or blocked task is asked anew under a new attempt; an open one says the teams already have it

findings.defect: On a real project the Lead always blocked, with advice that did not help
findings.scenario: no product code sets team_inputs, so every real project was blocked: attach a table
findings.cause: the teams read only declared fixture inputs until R3
findings.fix: the tools say plainly that the teams cannot read the project's data yet (R3), and the blocker names the real step

findings.defect: The approve and contact filter refused ordinary ML requests
findings.scenario: 'Predict which credit card applications are approved' was refused
findings.cause: any word starting with approv matched
findings.fix: only orders to approve or to contact customers are refused

findings.defect: A team agent could open or delegate a task owned by the Lead or Home; the built chat took one letter as the person's words
findings.scenario: Business opening a case for home was not refused; request 'a' passed as a quote
findings.cause: the rules returned None for any team agent; a substring check
findings.fix: team agents hand work only to teams and specialists; the built chat uses quote_ok (two whole words)

measurements.name: tests
measurements.result: test_lead_workspace 25 tests on files, PostgreSQL and signed in; the team, case agent, orchestrator, screens and web files pass

outcome: A person on Home can hand data work to the teams. The Lead asks Data Science, the team's question reaches the person in the Home chat, their answer goes back as theirs, and one joined report returns, with every step recorded and readable on the Workspace page.
lessons: Never run a second PostgreSQL test runner while a gate runs: both use the same per-worker database names.
A browser check finds what scripted tests miss: an invitation to answer that no code read.
A shared draft is not a private conversation: what a person's team work writes there needs its own reader check.
risks: The Lead decides by rules, so it proves the plumbing, not judgment.
The Home chat draws the report's four lines as one paragraph, because the Home page is another session's file this change did not touch.
Only one team question per Lead task is passed on (the reviewer's R8): harmless while every route names one team that asks once; a second team needs the relay keyed by the question.
